en:
Nyeeeh...? Do you want some of my
magic powder to cheer you up?

Sorry, but I'm out of magic powder right now.
Instead, I'll hit you with a magic hammer.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time chatting with Himiko, after
I politely declined the magic hammer.
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I grew a little closer today.
